# Panamanian RUC numbers, written the way the issuer publishes them: the
# register fields, and the two check digits (the DV) appended after a
# hyphen where they were published with the number.
#
# The bulk of these come from the DGI's own list of ITBMS withholding
# agents, which prints the DV beside every RUC:
# https://dgi.mef.gob.pa/itbms/Pdf-Retencion/LISTADO%20DE%20AGENTES%20DE%20RETENCION%20DEL%20ITBMS%20(GRANDES%20COMPRADORES)%202022.pdf
